title: Railway
description: Night-time developer calm: a deep ink-violet page, framed panels faintly tinted navy, slate teal or plum, near-black app windows, a muted violet primary, sea-green and copper accents and a magenta glow for the last call. Book-serif headings over Inter, JetBrains Mono for boards and status lines.
notes: dark is the faithful mode; light is a warm paper sibling with the same accents
IBM Plex Serif, Inter and JetBrains Mono are the original's own (open-licence) faces
chart-2 (green), chart-3 (copper) and chart-5 (steel blue) are the feature tones; chart-5 also tints the hero and build panels
